section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch49 — Andhra Pradesh — Deep
subject: Social Studies
stem: The Polavaram Project, a major multi-purpose irrigation project undertaken by Andhra Pradesh, is built across which river?
explanation: The Polavaram Project is built on the Godavari river in Andhra Pradesh, intended for irrigation, drinking water supply, and hydropower generation across multiple districts.

section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch49 — Andhra Pradesh — Deep
subject: Social Studies
stem: The Sri Venkateswara Temple, one of the world's most-visited pilgrimage sites, is located atop which hills in Andhra Pradesh?
explanation: The Sri Venkateswara Temple is located atop the Tirumala Hills (part of the Eastern Ghats) in Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh.

section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch49 — Andhra Pradesh — Deep
subject: Social Studies
stem: Visakhapatnam, one of Andhra Pradesh's most important port cities, is primarily located along which coastline?
explanation: Visakhapatnam lies on Andhra Pradesh's east coast along the Bay of Bengal, making it one of India's major natural harbours and a key naval/commercial port.
